title: Group link
summary: An admin makes one link that brings people into the group, and sends it in any chat (ADR 0184, bipe-chat/bipe#744). A link from an admin with a verified name also signs people up past the waitlist. Opens from the row bipe_group_link_title in group-details.

phase.description: loading: GET /v1/me/group-links?room_id runs. none: no active link; bipe_group_link_body, bipe_group_link_service_note and bipe_group_link_create. active: the link with its counts, bipe_group_link_share and bipe_group_link_revoke. working: create or revoke runs; the buttons are disabled. failed: bipe_error_network with bipe_app_retry, or bipe_group_link_error_access after a 404 or a 409.

code.description: The code of link, when this phone kept it at creation (per room ID, in the app's own store). Never logged.

signsUp.description: link.signs_up. true: bipe_group_link_signs_up with signups_left. false: bipe_group_link_existing_only.

expires.description: link.expires_at as a short date, in bipe_group_link_expires.

appear.effect: GET /v1/me/group-links with roomId. The newest link is link; a kept code for another link ID is dropped.

create.effect: When the service account (BipeOfficialAccounts groups) is not a joined or invited member: Room.inviteUserById. When its power level is below the invite level: Room.updatePowerLevelsForUsers with the invite level (RoomPowerLevels.values.invite). Then POST /v1/me/group-links. The code is kept for roomId and the share sheet opens at once with bipe_group_link_message (group name, link url). Phase active.

share.effect: With a kept code: the system share sheet with bipe_group_link_message. Without one: an alert with bipe_group_link_no_code and bipe_group_link_create.

revoke.effect: A confirm with bipe_group_link_revoke_body. DELETE /v1/me/group-links/{id}; the kept code goes. Phase none. The service account stays in the group: the admin removes it in group-members like any member.

notes: The row shows for members whose power level is 50 or more and who can change power levels (RoomPowerLevels.canOwnUserSendState for m.room.power_levels). The server checks the level again.
bipe_group_link_message is the text a person sends (people voice, pra). It works without the link preview.
Default chosen (bipe-chat/bipe#744): the screen does not name WhatsApp, because linguagem.md asks for neutral words about other apps (ADR 0129). The link works in any app. mz can overrule.
Default chosen (bipe-chat/bipe#744): the code stays only on the phone that made it, because the server keeps only its hash, as for invites. Another admin or phone makes a new link. mz can overrule.
The service account has no E2EE device: it gets no room keys and reads no message (security.md). It shows in group-members with the Bipe badge (official account).
